Primary request: create a moderately closer frontal camera view of this same school entrance as a continuous cinematic frame. The double blue-gray metal doors with diagonal panel markings are open inward by about 70 degrees, each leaf visible on its side on coherent side hinges. The opening is a pure solid black interior, approximately 16% of image width by 34% of image height, centered at x=50%, y=55%. Keep the original horizon and perspective with no lateral camera shift. Style/medium: crisp detailed pixel art, matching the reference exactly; hard pixel edges, no blur, no photorealism.
Composition/framing: horizontal 16:9, 1280x720 target, moderately closer frontal view, centered doorway.

Materials/textures: retain pixelated orange brick, blue lower facade, blue-gray metal, asphalt and sidewalk.
Constraints: interior must be pure black. Preserve architecture and original proportions. Door leaves open inward. No new architecture.
Avoid: stairs, signs, lights, new windows, people, wood doors, giant arches, camera side shift, blur, photorealism, painterly filter, text, watermark.
